fact: An NTRA national projects head told the parliamentary committee about EGP 60bn was invested in phase 1 of the infrastructure project (2019-2021) and phase 2 is targeted at about EGP 40bn, with fixed broadband strategic objectives for 2022-2025.
title: “القومى للاتصالات”: 40 مليار جنيه للمرحلة الثانية من تطوير البنية المعلوماتية
